title: Span Scout: Snapshot Panel for Correlated Request Drilldown
creator: Aisha Navarro
description: Design and prototype a compact 'Snapshot Panel' UI for the Redwood Console trace drilldown. The Snapshot Panel (Span Scout) surfaces a concise, actionable view of a selected request and its most relevant spans without leaving the dashboard context. It should help engineers rapidly identify latency hotspots, correlate external IDs (correlation_id, request_id), surface cost-affecting spans (e.g., heavy token generation or large embedding calls), and offer quick actions (open full trace, pin to investigation, create rollback/rollout note). Scope includes interaction patterns for timeline scrubbing, span grouping, inline filter editing, and lightweight annotations. Must integrate with existing Console rollouts/cost views: show per-span cost estimate and link to Optimize suggestions. Prototype required for usability testing and engineering handoff. Constraints: conserve vertical real-estate for dashboard users, maintain keyboard navigation, and avoid adding heavy network requests on initial panel open (prefetch strategies must be considered).
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot Panel opens from trace list and from per-request row without page transition
Timeline scrub shows span focus and updates context snapshot in under 150ms on typical production-size traces
Correlation IDs (correlation_id, trace_id, request_id) displayed and copyable; clicking opens search prefilled
Per-span cost estimate shown when cost-analytics data available; links to Optimize suggestions
Inline filter control lets user toggle service/operation/span-type and updates list & timeline in <200ms
Prototype tested with 5 engineers and 3 PM/design reviewers; usability issues documented and prioritized
Design tokens and component specs exported in Figma for engineering handoff

design_decisions: Prefer a single-panel overlay rather than full-page navigation to reduce cognitive context switching for tenants with many small traces
Show coarse cost estimates in the list and lazy-load detail on expansion to reduce initial payload
Group spans by service by default, with secondary groupings for latency and cost buckets to help triage
Expose correlation IDs prominently and make them actionable (copy/search/telemetry link)
Provide a pin action that persists the snapshot across route navigations and attaches to an investigation checklist
